title: RPG Maker XP - Keyboard and switches

posts.author: Simo1709
posts.body:
Good morning. I'm looking for a script that could let my character move using WASD instead of the arrows. Moreover, I wanted to create a "Goals menu" that the player could open by keeping the button TAB pressed (and that could disappear as soon as the button was released) and in which a message box showed the current missions that the player had to follow. Maybe with some switches?
(Like: If switch 'Mission #1' in ON => Display "[Text about mission #1]" in the menu)
Is it a way to do that? I'm not very good at creating scripts, so if one already exists or is easily writable maybe I'll keep it in the game, or else is there another way to achieve this? Hope I was clear

posts.author: AkiraKotatsuhime
posts.body:
One would need to code that by themself and please keep in mind not everyone on this planet is a fan of being forced to use WASD-move-jumblebumble, keyboards have arrow-keys for a reason.
This script may help getting started faster, since it gives you full keyboard-access:
★
SimpleKeyboardInput.rb
It uses
the same function-names
as the
[Input]-module
and adds
[toggle?]
to it to check current state of keys (usually NUM, CAPS and SCROLL). Individual keys are referenced by
their VK-ID
. Be sure to not use [Input] and [Keyboard] at the same time.
The script requires WindowsAPI to provide these features, so it will make your game incompatible to programs that are replacements for Game.exe, such as mkxp or RGD.
～炬燵あ
